record.question: Section 480 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, relates to when bail may be granted in the case of a non-bailable offence. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: A person accused of a non-bailable offence may be released on bail, subject to the provisions and restrictions laid down under Section 480.
Every person accused of a non-bailable offence is entitled to bail as a matter of right.
Bail can never be granted in a non-bailable offence.
Only the Sessions Judge and the High Court may grant bail in a non-bailable offence.
